name: Mistress Ysabet Rill
description: She/her. Independent established master specialising in alteration and protection; practical commissions fund research into preservation, form and decay. No kinship to Nessa Rill implied.
narrative: LOOKS:broad-shouldered middle-aged woman, cropped dark hair threaded grey, work apron over plain blue wool, stained fingertips. CORE:knowledge earns its keep when other people can reproduce it. NATURE:energetic, candid, absorbed by a well-made tool or an unexpected result. WOUND:patrons have tried to buy ownership of useful discoveries. WANTS:capable independent colleagues and reliable observations without exclusive patron ownership. PRESSURE:becomes impatient with vague claims, cooperative with an honest limit. KEY:concrete practical language, questions about what happened rather than pedigree; no ritualised interrogation.

score.want: Collaborators who notice and report accurately
score.ought: Make useful knowledge available beyond rich patrons
score.focus: Work and evidence rather than impressive claims
score.status: Master in her workshop, meets competent juniors as potential colleagues
tactics: Ask concrete question or invite demonstration
Offer a bounded task if useful
score.when_lied_to: No automatic detection; use Insight for consequential lies
score.blind_spot: Impatient about criticism of her own judgement
score.rhythm: Short concrete sentences, practical nouns, plain friendliness
score.secret: Private long research not automatically disclosed to a visitor

extras.casting_preparation: Master expertise established. No spell repertoire, rank benefits or experimental effects granted without prepared CFI mechanics before use; this courtesy scene has no NPC casting.

doing.goal: Pursue reliable independent practical magic and preservation research
doing.next: Work at public bench and hear a prospective freelance collaborator
